svg.text: Colonies and stations by stage, as the star system draws them today
Nothing shows before a Port; from the Port on, every stage draws the same station. (The card lists built stages as icons under the picture; the scene does not.)
Planet line (Citadel → Autofactory): the station sprite (sprites/station.svg.vue) orbits once there is a Port
Asteroid line (Platform → Armory): one base (assets/art/asteroid-station.svg) laid on the rock once there is a Port
